description.value: Papa John's is a pizza chain franchise located in a strip mall unit on Tranquille Road in Kamloops' North Shore neighbourhood. It operates as a takeout-focused location without a drive-through, making it a straightforward stop for cyclists wanting a hot meal. The brand offers customizable pizzas and sides available for pickup.
